supersedes.record: The prior SW0116 registered preflight stopped at a failed guard and remains preserved unchanged. SW0117 keeps its source, data, arms, objective, optimizer, schedule, and promotion rule; it separates cache-input parity from same-input implementation identity.

source: Whole matched SW0097 positive_frozen source core, seed 0; registered encoder and preprocessing assets.

source_endpoint_review.runtime_enforced: Both SW0117 train arms validate report SHA, source/encoder/preprocessing SHAs, fixed evaluation contract, finite per-image metrics, and recorded means before creating a training output directory.

pilot.training_ids: Exact matched SW0097 4096 IDs and order; shuffle seed 117; rows mapped to the registered 70k pool.
pilot.optimizer: Fresh Adam, same parameter groups and initialization in both arms.
frozen: none of core, legacy graph, or encoder; all are trainable in both arms

objective.control: phase_primary + 5 * positive product of actual four-component spike Pearson synchrony
objective.candidate: same control objective + lambda_joint * SW0115 decoder-free analytic partition RGB loss
objective.rgb_loss: Reuse SW0115 loss.py unchanged: actual .50/min2/largest-component-background H, variable K with all omitted patches in background, exact-forward STE, native RGB patch means, image mean including K=1.
objective.q: Actual positive Pearson product from last_component_spikes, D=4, settle=32, affinity_mode=spike.
objective.lambda: Only candidate seed0 preflight: 0.25 * median(old total joint gradient norm / RGB-only total joint gradient norm) over first four registered TRAIN batches; saved once and immutable.

initial_guards: Regenerate gamma from registered encoder/preprocessing and exact RGB cache rows; max absolute difference from registered SW0097 gamma <= 2e-5. Record each cache-vs-live trace maximum without interpreting it as the gamma tolerance.
For input sensitivity only, require live-vs-cached old-loss absolute difference <=2e-5 and exact production labels/H.

Independently run the source-core reference on the exact same regenerated gamma detached; before any update require exact full traces, old loss, production labels, and hard H versus the live joint core. This same-input identity guard is separate from cache-vs-live input parity.

Both arms require finite nonzero old-objective gradients to encoder, graph, and non-graph core on each of the first four exact TRAIN batches. The candidate arm additionally requires finite nonzero RGB gradients to Q, encoder, graph, and non-graph core on each batch.

Verify initial source graph/encoder unchanged using cloned pre-update snapshots; on a throwaway real B16 Adam update, independently verify actual parameter changes in encoder, graph, and non-graph core.
Count-preserving H row scramble with repooling must increase mean per-image RGB loss.
No masks or other GT are read for gamma regeneration, losses, coefficient, preflight, or training.

evaluation.readout: Unchanged actual-event/gate/four-component spike-product classifier, threshold .50, min group size 2, largest-component background.
evaluation.gamma: Regenerated from each trained encoder and frozen registered preprocessing using byte-verified SW0106 validation RGB cache.

pilot_promotion_gate.candidate_fg_ari: Must exceed both matched SW0097 seed0 source FG-ARI and joint-control FG-ARI by at least 0.01.
pilot_promotion_gate.paired_image_bootstrap: Using the same paired 320 image indices and a preregistered deterministic 10000-draw bootstrap, candidate-minus-control AND candidate-minus-SW0097 FG-ARI 95% confidence-interval lower bounds must both be strictly positive.
pilot_promotion_gate.iou_margins: Candidate foreground IoU > 0.2535891312 and matched-object IoU > 0.2569369792 (matched Slot means + 0.05; strict greater-than).
pilot_promotion_gate.failure: Stop this recipe; no coefficient/threshold tuning or seed expansion.

scope: Seed0 matched paired pilot only; training tasks depend on external barrier sw0117_source_endpoint_reviewed. First record and review the live-encoder SW0097 source endpoint baseline; no training task may start before that barrier is completed. Later seeds require reviewed outcome.
